definition: a short high-pitched sound made by a bird or insect; to make such a sound
a rhythmic high-pitched sound, especially that made by an insect
translation: （昆虫发出的）唧唧声；发出唧唧声

definition: a loud, shrill, piercing sound; to make such a sound
translation: 尖锐刺耳的声音；发出尖锐声

definition: a moaning, murmuring, or whistling sound
to howl, wail, or lament loudly
a peregrine falcon; wandering or traveling
pleasantly smooth and musical to hear
a song, poem, or speech of mourning
